turns.user: Just PCS'd to Kaneohe Bay. Is there a newcomers brief?

Yes, Marine Corps Base Hawaii (Kaneohe Bay) hosts an in-person newcomers brief called the **New Arrivals Orientation** through MCCS Information, Referral, and Relocation Services (IRRS). Attendance is mandatory per MCO 1754.10B for service members and their families stationed at MCB Hawaii and Camp Smith.

### **New Arrivals Orientation Details**
* **Upcoming Dates:** 
  * Thursday, November 5, 2026
  * Thursday, December 3, 2026
* **Time:** 9:00 AM – 11:30 AM
* **Location:** Base Chapel, Building 6677, Cushman Avenue, MCBH
* **What to Expect:** Overview of base resources, local community insights, and connections to support programs for living in Hawaii.

### **Information, Referral, and Relocation Services (IRRS) Office**
Beyond the brief, the IRRS office offers local area guides, housing information, and a **Lending Locker** where you can borrow essential household items (like kitchenware and small appliances) while waiting for your household goods.
* **Location:** Reed Rd., Building 579, MCBH Kaneohe Bay, HI 96863
* **Office Hours:** Monday – Friday, 7:30 AM – 4:30 PM (Closed weekends and federal holidays)
* **Lending Locker Hours:** Monday – Friday, 8:00 AM – 3:00 PM (Call for an appointment)
* **Phone:** (808) 496-7786
* **Email:** OMBKBAY.MCBHIRRS@usmc-mccs.org

### **Next Steps**
1. **Register or Confirm Attendance:** Call IRRS at **(808) 496-7786** or email **OMBKBAY.MCBHIRRS@usmc-mccs.org** to sign up for the November 5 orientation.
2. **Need Household Items?** Call the same number to book an appointment with the Lending Locker at Building 579.
3. Let me know if you also need contacts for the Temporary Lodging Allowance (TLA) office, base housing, or Child & Youth Programs!

**Sources**

turns.user: What MCCS stuff is there in Hawaii?
turns.agent:
Marine Corps Community Services (MCCS) Hawaii serves Marines, Sailors, and families at **Marine Corps Base Hawaii (MCBH) Kaneohe Bay** and **Camp H.M. Smith**. They offer a full range of recreation, fitness, shopping, lodging, and family support programs across both locations.

### **Recreation & Fitness**
* **Beaches, Boating & Outdoors:** Fort Hase Beach and Hale Koa Beach (808-252-2948), marinas, boating and water sports, camping, and outdoor equipment rentals.
* **Golf, Bowling & Tickets:** Kaneohe Klipper Golf Course, bowling, and Information, Tickets & Tours (ITT) for island attractions at MCBH (808-970-5497) and Camp Smith (808-488-0810).
* **Fitness & Aquatics:** Semper Fit gyms (including unmanned access and the Camp Smith Gym at 808-869-5197), the Human Performance Center (808-970-5499), HITT, Group X classes, intramural sports, and base pools.
* **Single Marine Program (SMP):** Recreation centers open to single/unaccompanied active-duty E-5 and below at MCBH (808-254-7593) and Camp Smith (808-477-0808, facility open 24/7).

### **Hospitality, Lodging & Shopping**
* **Recreational & Temporary Lodging:** Beach Cottages, Cabanas at Kaneohe Bay, Klipper Villas, Fairway Inn (808-254-5696), and Inns of the Corps – Marine Lodge Five Palms.
* **Shopping & Services:** Marine Corps Exchange (MCX) and Mokapu Mall, Marine Marts, Barber Shops, Firestone Complete Auto Care (808-254-2258), UPS Store, and dry cleaning.
* **Dining:** Klipper Grill, Strikers Grill and Tap, SNCO Club, and Camp Smith's Aloha Kitchen (808-484-9419) and Sunset Lanai.

### **Marine & Family Support**
* **Child & Youth:** Child Development Centers, Family Child Care and Resource & Referral (808-496-7430), School Age Care, Youth Sports, New Parent Support, and the School Liaison Officer.
* **Family Readiness & Career:** Information, Referral & Relocation (808-496-7786), Exceptional Family Member Program (808-496-0290), Family Member Employment Assistance (808-496-7097), Personal Financial Management, Transition Readiness (TRP/SkillBridge), Education Center (808-496-2158), and the Base Library (808-254-7624).
* **Prevention & Counseling:** Community Counseling and Family Advocacy Program (808-496-7780).

### **Next Steps**
* **Tell me what you're looking for:** Let me know which specific activity, facility, or program you are interested in (and whether you are near **Kaneohe Bay** or **Camp Smith**), and I can pull up exact hours, building numbers, and details.
* **Looking for another branch's base?** If you are also looking for MWR facilities at Joint Base Pearl Harbor-Hickam or Schofield Barracks, let me know and I can point you to the official Navy or Army MWR resources.

### **Sources**
* [MCCS Hawaii Phonebook & Directory](https://hawaii.usmc-mccs.org/contact/directory)
* [MCCS Hawaii Recreation, Fitness & Family Programs](https://hawaii.usmc-mccs.org/)
* [MCCS Hawaii Single Marine Program Centers](https://hawaii.usmc-mccs.org/recreation-fitness/recreation-centers)
* [MCCS Hawaii Overview](https://hawaii.usmc-mccs.org/about/things-to-do)

**Service Notice:** The MCAS New River All Points Travel (Information, Tickets, and Tours) office (Bldg. 4044, Curtis Road) is closed until further notice. Please use the Camp Lejeune All Points Travel office (910-451-3535) for travel and ticket assistance.

MCCS does not operate a ski resort at MCB Camp Lejeune. Because Camp Lejeune is located on the coastal plain of North Carolina, there are no snow skiing facilities aboard the installation. 

However, MCCS Lejeune-New River offers several ways to plan an off-base trip, get out on the water, or enjoy on-base coastal recreation:

*   **Plan a Trip (Information, Tickets, and Tours / All Points Travel):** If you are looking to book a winter ski trip, vacation package, or hotel, or purchase discounted attraction tickets, visit All Points Travel.
    *   **Location:** Bldg. 84, Holcomb Blvd. (Hadnot Point Plaza), Camp Lejeune
    *   **Phone:** 910-451-3535
    *   **Hours:** Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM (Closed Saturday & Sunday)
*   **Coastal Resort & Lodging (Onslow Beach Recreation Area):** MCCS operates its own beachfront resort and campground aboard Camp Lejeune, featuring beach cottages, lodges, and an RV park.
    *   **Location:** BA-275 Beach Rd., Camp Lejeune
    *   **Phones:** Reservations: 910-440-7502 | Information: 910-440-7259
*   **Water Sports & Boating (Gottschalk Marina):** If you meant water skiing, boating, or paddling, Gottschalk Marina rents motorized skiffs, pontoon boats, kayaks, canoes, and stand-up paddleboards.
    *   **Location:** Bldg. 198, Julian C. Smith Rd., Camp Lejeune
    *   **Phone:** 910-451-8307
    *   **Hours:** Friday–Sunday, 8:00 AM – 4:00 PM (Closed Monday–Thursday)
*   **Outdoor Adventures & Gear Rentals:** Offers mountain bike rentals, primitive camping at Brewster Campground, and recreational equipment checkout.
    *   **Location:** Bldg. 1100, West Rd. (customer entrance on Ash St.), Camp Lejeune

    *   **Hours:** Mon, Thu, Fri 8:00 AM – 3:00 PM; Tue & Wed 8:00 AM – 12:00 PM (Closed Sat & Sun)

**Next Steps**
*   Call **All Points Travel** at 910-451-3535 to ask about military discounts on off-base ski resorts, lodging, and travel packages.
*   Contact **Outdoor Adventures** at 910-451-1368 or **Onslow Beach** at 910-440-7502 to book local outdoor recreation and lodging.

turns.user: ¿Dónde puedo inscribir a mi hijo en la guardería en Camp Pendleton?
turns.agent:
Para inscribir a su hijo en la guardería en Camp Pendleton, primero debe crear una cuenta y enviar una solicitud de cuidado infantil en línea a través de **MilitaryChildCare.com**, o bien acudir directamente a la oficina de **Resource & Referral (R&R)** de la base.

**Opciones de cuidado infantil en Camp Pendleton (Child and Youth Programs)**
* **Child Development Centers (CDC):** Centros de cuidado en la base para niños desde las 6 semanas hasta los 5 años de edad.
* **Family Child Care (FCC):** Cuidado infantil certificado en hogares dentro de la base para niños de 6 semanas a 12 años, con horarios más flexibles.
* **School Age Care (SAC):** Cuidado antes y después de la escuela, así como durante vacaciones y campamentos de verano, para niños de 5 a 12 años.

**Elegibilidad y Requisitos**
* **Elegibilidad:** Disponible para hijos de miembros en servicio activo, empleados civiles del DoD, reservistas y contratistas del DoD (los espacios se asignan según el orden de prioridad del DoD).
* **Salud y Vacunación:** Todos los niños deben contar con su cartilla de vacunación al día según las regulaciones estatales y del DoD. Durante el registro se debe informar sobre cualquier necesidad médica, de desarrollo o alimentaria especial.

**Oficina Local de Inscripción y Asistencia (Resource & Referral)**
* **Ubicación:** Edificio (BLDG) 13150, #112, Camp Pendleton, CA *(Nota: algunas guías oficiales también listan la oficina en el salón #111 del mismo edificio)*.
* **Teléfono:** (760) 725-9723
* **Correo electrónico:** resourcesreferralscp@usmc-mccs.org o mccspendleton.resourcereferral@usmc-mccs.org
* **Horario de atención:** Lunes a viernes, de 7:30 a.m. a 4:30 p.m. *(cerrado en días festivos federales)*.

**Próximos pasos (Next Steps)**
1. **Solicite su espacio en línea:** Ingrese a [MilitaryChildCare.com](https://militarychildcare.com) para crear un perfil familiar, buscar los programas disponibles en Camp Pendleton (CDC, FCC o SAC) y unirse a la lista de espera.
2. **Comuníquese con Resource & Referral:** Una vez enviada su solicitud (o si necesita ayuda con el proceso, tarifas o cuidado fuera de la base), llame al **(760) 725-9723** o visite el Edificio 13150 para completar los formularios de inscripción y entregar los registros de vacunación.

**Sources**
* [MCCS Camp Pendleton – Child and Youth Programs](https://pendleton.usmc-mccs.org/marine-family-support/child-and-youth)
* [MCCS Camp Pendleton – Family Child Care & Resource and Referral](https://pendleton.usmc-mccs.org/marine-family-support/child-and-youth/family-child-care)
